'''Hsin the Moon Fox''' is one of [[Huanglong]]'s seven [[Sentinel]]s.<ref>{{Quest|Utterance of Marvels: I}}
:'''Yangyang:''' Yes, the one we built this statue for. The {{rubi|Sentinel|Oracle Engine}} in Jinzhou. There is one capital and six cities in Huanglong, with each city having its own Sentinel. While they share some similarities in appearance, there are also differences.</ref> It is the original Sentinel of [[Mengzhou]]<ref name="MENGZHOU">{{Quest|Simulacrum of the Heart}}
:'''Wenshu:''' Sentinel Jué has long shielded Mt. Firmament, just as Mengzhou relies on Lady Hsin the Moon Fox. If Jinzhou is to be our first step toward reclaiming our lands, we cannot simply leave the entire burden to the Sentinels.</ref> who was assassinated by [[Balanophora]] 200 years ago, right after the end of the [[Fortress and Gorges War]]. It was succeeded by [[Hsin]], a clone It created using Its powers of fractal proliferation.<ref>{{Quest|Simulacrum of the Heart}}
:'''{{Rover}}:''' If you are a fractal form of Hsin the Moon Fox, then what of the real Sentinel...?</ref>
